entities.name: Dollun Spinebreaker
entities.description: A criminal rhox warrior from Alara, once a proud Bant military commander who went mad in war.

entities.name: Eleventh Legion
entities.description: Legion of soldiers, Sigiled paladins and leotau cavalry commanded by Dollun, nearly lost in Naya.

entities.name: Army of Jhess
entities.description: Bant army in which Dollun rose as a champion.

entities.name: Sigiled caste
entities.description: Caste in which Dollun rose to Knight-Captain.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Dollun was wanted for dereliction of duty.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard where Dollun's campaign was catastrophic.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: Shard where Dollun escaped into a lowland chasm.

entities.name: Jhess-Valeron conflict
entities.description: Conflict in which Dollun commanded the Eleventh Legion.

entities.name: Prayer to Asha
entities.description: Religious text Dollun recited before battle and later in raving.

events.summary: Dollun rises meteorically to Knight-Captain in seven years and commands the Eleventh Legion in the Jhess-Valeron conflict.
events.quote: earning the title of Knight-Captain in only seven years

events.summary: Once war between the shards begins, Dollun sees his men slain in a chaotic campaign into Naya, shattering his sense of propriety and honor.
events.quote: This experience shattered Dollun's sense of propriety and honor

events.summary: After losing nearly all of the Eleventh Legion, Dollun emerges in tribal garb with two spiked maces, butchers Naya and Jund enemies, and escapes into a Jund chasm.
events.quote: he escaped into one of the lowland chasms of Jund

events.summary: Dollun travels to the other shards, meting out justice as he sees fit.
events.quote: he traveled to the other shards, meting out justice as he saw fit

relations.quote: he was the commander of the Eleventh Legion of Soldiers
one of the foremost rhox champions of the army of Jhess
